## `:::{.focus-list}` gives you a nice neat way to make lists that reveal incrementally with previous bullets fading out

```md
:::{.focus-list}
- I am the first list item
- I am the second list item
- And I am the third
:::
```

:::{.focus-list}
- I am the first list item
- I am the second list item
- And I am the third
:::



## As this approach using native Quarto unfortunately doesn't work...

```md
:::{.incremental .fade-in-then-semi-out}
- I am the first list item
- I am the second list item
- And I am the third
:::
```

:::{.incremental .fade-in-then-semi-out}
- I am the first list item
- I am the second list item
- And I am the third
:::


## And this is a pain and runs the risk of lots of mismatched fragments (ask me how I know...)

```md
::: {.fragment .fade-in-then-semi-out}
- I am the first list item
:::
::: {.fragment .fade-in-then-semi-out}
- I am the second list item
:::
::: {.fragment}
- And I am the third
:::
```


::: {.fragment .fade-in-then-semi-out}
- I am the first list item
:::
::: {.fragment .fade-in-then-semi-out}
- I am the second list item
:::
::: {.fragment}
- And I am the third
:::
